title: Introduction to Theories of Counselling
description: Major theoretical approaches to counselling. Includes philosophical assumptions, key concepts, the process of change and interventions. Designed for those interested in counselling, psychotherapy and helping relationships.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CNPY 418, ED-D 418.
CNPY 418 is a prerequisite course for the master's program in Counselling Psychology and must be completed within seven years of the date of application.
